### The God of Great Reversals
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-september-18-2023.html
Passage: Esther 9:1
Points:
- Haman expected to obliterate the Jews, but God overturned the plan on the exact day chosen for their destruction.
- While Haman’s family fell from pride to devastation, Mordecai was elevated from obscurity to honor.
- God's people celebrated their deliverance with praise rather than gloating over defeated foes.
- God specializes in turning curses into blessings, demonstrated supremely at the cross of Jesus Christ.
- Believers facing impossible or hopeless circumstances can rely on God's power to redeem and deliver.

### Holy War
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/holy-war
Passage: Esther 9:1
Points:
- By refusing to take plunder, the Jews showed their battle was holy war rather than personal enrichment.
- Under the new covenant, God calls believers to wage spiritual warfare through Gospel proclamation and prayer rather than the sword.
- All people are naturally enemies of God deserving destruction, but Christ took that punishment on behalf of His people.
- Christians are called to love their enemies and pray that the Holy Spirit converts their hearts.
